correctness.rationale: Exact creation identities and a summation-by-parts quadratic remainder (checked exhaustively at small sizes) reduce triangle counts to weighted centered-bit sums. Stationary Pólya word law yields exact innovation variance v=rho(1-rho)[1+2M delta+M(M-1)delta^2/(1+delta)]. A bounded martingale functional central limit theorem and uniform remainder O_P(n^2) establish the process-level joint Gaussian limit, positive-definite density covariance, and the 2/15 excess coefficient. The standalone checker passed 8,615 exact assertions; finite testing is not used as proof.

value.rationale: Triangle density and normalized edge density are central, naturally comparable invariants. The first-order relation t_n→rho² could conceal second-order degeneracy, but the proof determines a strictly positive residual with exact factor (2/15)rho³(1-rho)D_M. The joint covariance is positive definite, so this is not an edge-only theorem in disguise. The memory multiplier quantitatively identifies the role of reinforcement in motif fluctuations.
